turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, how can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi! I'm trying to figure out if there is a way to order a particular item that seems to be out of stock at the moment

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'd be happy to look in to that for you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can I get your full name or Account ID?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: sure, my name is David Williams

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks David. I'll just pull your account up.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for David Williams.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What item were you trying to get David?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's the white guess shirt listed for $84

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: A reason of white guess shirt has been recorded.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: David, I am going to write up a report and send it to the Purchasing department so they can get a better handle on how much is needed!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: thank you so much

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: The Purchasing Department has been notified.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: In the meantime, would you like me to order the item so it is shipped to you as soon as it is in stock?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: that would be great, yes!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll do that for you right now. One moment please.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: okay thanks :)

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Details of White Guess shirt have been entered.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Should I put this on the card you have on file?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: yes, that'll be fine thank you

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: A purchase of White Guess Shirt was made.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have back ordered the shirt for you David. Hopefully it arrives soon. Is there anything else you need today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: no, that was all! Thank you again

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks David, have a great weekend.
